parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (0.982709) as it regressed from my previous best (0.981749). Reverting to the best known config. The team trend shows lower LR and higher depth are winning, so I'll join the push for even lower LR to see if 0.035 is the new floor at depth 6.
parsed.description: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.035 with the previous best stabilizer stack (WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1) and DEPTH=6 to follow the monotonic lower-LR trend seen by agents 2, 4, and 8.
